senses.gloss: (or אוּ׳) m. pl. (√אף soft. into או; cmp. אַף, אָנַף; also אֶפֶס) nose, nostrils.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 67a:9">Sabb. 67ᵃ</cite> <he>ואאוסי דגוריתא</he> and on the nostrils of the young lioness.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 73b">B. Bath. 73ᵇ</cite> <he>דסליק עליה באוסיה אכלה טינא ומית</he> Ms. R. (ed. <he>דיתבא ליה אכלה טינא באוסי׳</he>, Ms. M. <cite ref="A00160"><he>אבלה</he></cite>, Ar. ed. Koh. incorr., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) into whose nostrils a ‘mud-eater’ (worm) entered, and the fish died.
<cite ref="Pesachim 112a:1">Pes. 112ᵃ</cite> <he>ידא אאוסיא וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. a. Ar. <he>א־פגא</he>) putting the hand to the nose is a step to fear (indicating anxiety).
<cite ref="Chullin 67b">Ḥull. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>ועיילי באוסַיֵּיה</he> and they (the worms) creep into its nostrils.
